# DJ Pazo

> DJ Pazo is a professional DJ and MC based in Northwest Arkansas (NWA), serving weddings, private events, nightlife venues, and events across Arkansas and beyond.

## Business identity

- Public brand: DJ Pazo
- Legal business name: Pazo Entertainment LLC
- Website: https://djpazo.com/
- Email: pazobeatzz@gmail.com
- Phone: +1-479-426-6076
- Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/DJ_Pazo_official/
- Primary service area: Northwest Arkansas
- Regular service cities: Bentonville, Rogers, Fayetteville, and Springdale, Arkansas
- Travel: Accepts bookings outside Arkansas; travel fees are assessed case by case, usually based on mileage.
- Languages: English and conversational Spanish

## Services

DJ Pazo provides DJ and MC services for:
- Weddings and wedding receptions
- Nightclubs and club events
- Bars and restaurants
- Private parties and birthdays
- Quinceañeras
- Corporate events
- School dances and proms
- College events
- Festivals, concerts, and live events
- Holiday parties and other special events

Available production and event services may include a professional sound system, wireless microphones, DJ lighting, moving-head lighting, ceremony audio, separate cocktail-hour audio, and backup equipment. Confirm the specific equipment and services needed for an event when requesting a quote.

Optional add-ons include extra hours, lighting upgrades, and dance-floor effects.

## Music and approach

Genres include pop, 2000s and 2010s hits, EDM, house, hip-hop, R&B, Latin, Top 40, remixes, throwbacks, Christian music, and custom playlists. DJ Pazo emphasizes seamless transitions, technical mixing, production, MC services, and custom playlists. Playlists are tailored to each event, and song requests are accepted.

## Published pricing

### Wedding packages

**Essential Wedding Reception Package — $795**
- Four hours of reception coverage
- DJ and MC / announcement services
- Professional reception sound system
- Microphone for speeches and toasts
- Dance-floor lighting package with two party lights
- DJ booth facade
- Customized playlist planning and music requests
- Grand entrance music coordination
- First dance, parent dances, and special-moment coordination
- Setup and breakdown
- Travel included within 25 miles; additional travel fees may apply outside that area

**Signature Wedding Reception Package — $995**
Includes everything in the Essential package, plus:
- Wedding ceremony audio coverage
- Additional microphone for the officiant
- Cocktail-hour music coverage
- Upgraded dance-floor lighting effects
- Up to six hours of total coverage
- Dedicated pre-wedding planning consultation
- Timeline coordination with the venue and vendors
- Early setup before guest arrival

**Private events:** The stated rate is $100 per hour plus a flat $150 fee. Confirm the final quote and what is included directly with DJ Pazo.

Prices, package details, travel charges, and availability should be confirmed directly before booking.
